service.description: Read a statement file (BAI2, OFX or CSV with its mapping) for a bank account and keep it for review: each row is new, a duplicate of a line already imported or of a row before it in the file (by its identity: the bank's FIT id in OFX, the source-row key in BAI2 and CSV), or rejected with its error. Refuses a file that is not the bank account's (its routing or account number or currency) or that has no rows. Needs BANK_RECONCILE for the bank account.

service.description: Start a statement session for a bank account: its statement reference, period and balances. The opening balance is the closing balance of the last finished statement before it, and is required only for the first one. Refuses a period that overlaps another session of the bank account, a thru day before the from day, and an opening balance that differs from the last finished closing balance. Needs BANK_RECONCILE for the bank account.

service.description: Change a statement session in progress: its reference and closing balance, and the bank lines it clears (clearFitIdList) or no longer clears (unclearFitIdList). A cleared line is of the bank account, posted in the period, and matched or not reconciled with a reason. Refuses a finished session, a stale revision (lastUpdatedStamp, when given), and a line another session cleared, naming it; the line is read under lock, so two sessions cannot clear one line. Needs BANK_RECONCILE for the bank account.

return.message: RECONCILIATION_UNAVAILABLE: The statement is not available
RECONCILIATION_FINISHED: Statement ${bankReconciliationId} is finished

service.description: Add or change a bank match rule of the organization, or end it (ended Y). A rule needs its match text; one that applies on its own (autoApply) needs the party whose payments it finds. Refuses a bank account of another organization, an amount range that ends before it starts and an unknown or private party. Its fields are audit-logged. Needs BANK_RECONCILE in the organization.

return.message: RULE_UNAVAILABLE: The bank rule is not available
MATCH_TEXT_REQUIRED: Give the text the rule matches
RULE_PARTY_REQUIRED: A rule that applies on its own needs its party
AMOUNT_RANGE_INVALID: The amount range ends before it starts
DIRECTION_INVALID: Choose money in or money out
PARTY_UNAVAILABLE: The rule's party is not available

set.from: {organizationPartyId:organizationPartyId, paymentMethodId:paymentMethodId || null, description:description || null, sequenceNum:sequenceNum ?? 10, matchText:matchText, directionEnumId:directionEnumId || null, amountFrom:amountFrom, amountThru:amountThru, partyId:partyId || null, autoApply:autoApply == 'Y' ? 'Y' : 'N'}

service.description: Preview a bank match rule, stored (bankMatchRuleId) or as it is being written (its fields), against the open bank lines of the organization without changing anything: every line it matches, the payments it finds for each, whether the match is ambiguous (no payment, several, or another rule matching first or with another party) and whether it would apply. Needs the read of check#BankAccess.

Reconcile the open bank lines of the organization (or of one bank account) that its rules match exactly: one rule with autoApply matches the line, no other rule does, and it finds exactly one payment, which no other line claims. Every other match stays a suggestion. Each line is reconciled in its own transaction, and one that fails is named. Needs BANK_RECONCILE.
